free_text: The decision to recommend biopsy is clear as the prior, guideline criterion, and retrieved evidence all converged on this recommendation. The PI-RADS 5 finding on the mpMRI was decisive, aligning with the guideline criterion for re-biopsy when such a lesion is identified. This finding was supported by the PSA trend data and the context of the prior negative biopsy, which made the re-biopsy necessary.
